04 / DO NOT PAY TWICE
Signed bytes are written durably before broadcast. After a crash or transport timeout, the operator checks the same signature and USDC deltas. It can resend the identical transaction while valid; an expired uncertain outcome stops for inspection. It never silently signs a replacement.
Offline tests cover crash after send, ambiguous acceptance and expiry. The live broadcast/crash/recovery proof remains pending funding. Owner revocation and return of USDC are exercised with fixture balances in LiteSVM.
